Standard: AR probe and drogue lights conform to SAE ARP5825, Requirements for Probe/Drogue Style Refueling Lights paragraph, MIL-A-19736, Light paragraph, JSSG-2010-5, Aerial Refueling Lights section, ATP-3.3.4.2, Probe and Drogue section, and JSSG-2009, Probe Illumination section. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Test installed lighting on the air vehicle and verify conformance to SAE ARP5825, Requirements for Probe/Drogue Style Refueling Lights paragraph, MIL-A- 19736, Light paragraph, JSSG-2010-5, Aerial Refueling Lights section, ATP-3.3.4.2, Probe and Drogue section, and JSSG-2009, Probe Illumination section.
